crossRefs.note: No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will…
Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid, and don’t be dismayed. Take all the warriors with you, and arise, go up to Ai.…
Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid because of them; for tomorrow at this time, I will deliver them up all slain…
Yahweh said to me, “Don’t fear him; for I have delivered him, with all his people, and his land, into your hand. You…
When you go out to battle against your enemies, and see horses, chariots, and a people more numerous than you, you…
Deborah said to Barak, “Go; for this is the day in which Yahweh has delivered Sisera into your hand. Hasn’t Yahweh gone…
Yahweh confused Sisera, all his chariots, and all his army, with the edge of the sword before Barak. Sisera abandoned…
Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help…
What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t fear them, for I have delivered them into your hands. Not a man of them will stand before you.”
translations.bsb: The LORD said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them, for I have delivered them into your hand. Not one of them shall stand against you.”
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thine hand; there shall not a man of them stand before
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thy hands; there shall not a man of them stand before thee.
